answer: Audit authored answers for near-duplication across identities. Shingle each submission into overlapping n-grams, hash to a sketch, and cluster identities by sketch similarity. Honest authors scatter wide, a river delta of distinct phrasings; a template farm reusing one mold collapses into a tight cluster of improbable overlap however it swaps surface words, since shingles catch structural reuse beneath the opal veneer. Flag any group whose pairwise similarity rises like a falcon above baseline and route it to hard re-grade; a swarm of clones indicts itself by its sameness.
